calibration.quantity: volume-equivalent diameter of the archived radar and light-curve model
calibration.reference: DAMIT model 4390 calibrated size, Rożek et al. (2019), A&A 631, A149
calibration.notes: DAMIT marks model 4390 as size-calibrated (D = 0.448 km, σ = 0.02 km); radar delay-Doppler images fix the scale. NEOWISE lists 0.451 ± 0.026 km (JPL SBDB), consistent within the quoted error.
calibration.sourceLabel: DAMIT model 4390 calibrated size, Rożek et al. (2019), A&A 631, A149
calibration.diameterSemantics: volume-equivalent diameter of the archived radar and light-curve model
calibration.limitations: Uniform scale of the unchanged archived mesh by the adopted diameter and its quoted uncertainty. DAMIT marks model 4390 as size-calibrated (D = 0.448 km, σ = 0.02 km); radar delay-Doppler images fix the scale. NEOWISE lists 0.451 ± 0.026 km (JPL SBDB), consistent within the quoted error.

modelLimitations: The nonconvex model, fitted to light curves and radar delay-Doppler images, resolves large concavities where those data constrain them; craters and fine relief are unresolved.
